text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I tried borrowing a fashion magazine from the library...
It has so much stuff written in it...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Still, just a little bit more...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"This is another necessary step
toward becoming a wonderful adult, right?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see...
I understand now...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, Nishino Flower got absorbed in the fashion magazine and ended up going to bed late that night...
